customer_text: My iPhone 7 battery drops from 100% to 20% in an hour of normal use.
reference_reply: We can help check this. Go to Settings > Battery to see which apps are using the most power. What version of iOS are you on?

customer_text: My iPhone X gets extremely hot to the touch while charging with the included charger.
reference_reply: Safety is our priority. Does this occur on multiple outlets or while using specific apps? Remove any thick case while charging.

customer_text: Phone suddenly shuts down when battery percentage reaches 30%.
reference_reply: We would like to check your battery health. Head to Settings > Battery > Battery Health. Does it display a service notification?

customer_text: My battery drains so quickly overnight when the phone is just sitting on the table.
reference_reply: Let us investigate. Check Settings > Battery to see if background app activity or notifications ran overnight.

customer_text: Is it normal for an iPhone 8 battery health to be at 82% after 10 months?
reference_reply: Apple batteries are designed to retain up to 80% capacity at 500 charge cycles. Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health.

customer_text: My phone will not charge at all. Tried three different lightning cables and wall blocks.
reference_reply: Inspect the charging port for lint or debris with a flashlight. Try a gentle clean with a wooden toothpick or soft brush.

customer_text: Wireless charging pad stopped working with my iPhone 8 after the latest update.
reference_reply: Ensure the case is not too thick or metallic, and center the phone on the Qi pad. Has the device been restarted since the update?

customer_text: Battery indicator is stuck at 1% even after charging for 4 hours.
reference_reply: Let us force restart your iPhone to recalibrate the sensor. Press and quickly release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then hold the Side button.

customer_text: My iPad battery takes 8 hours to reach full charge with the 12W adapter.
reference_reply: Make sure you are using the official 12W adapter and Apple cable directly plugged into a wall outlet, not a computer USB port.

customer_text: Ever since installing iOS 11.0.3 my battery life is cut in half.
reference_reply: After updates, background indexing can temporarily impact battery life for 48 hours. Let us monitor Settings > Battery.

customer_text: Phone shows charging icon but the battery percentage keeps decreasing.
reference_reply: This can happen if high-load apps draw more power than the charger supplies. Are you using an Apple-certified MFi charger?

customer_text: My MacBook Pro says Service Recommended on the battery icon in the menu bar.
reference_reply: When Service Recommended appears, your battery needs hardware evaluation. Meet us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport to book a Genius Bar appointment.

customer_text: The back glass of my iPhone is bulging and pushed outward near the battery!
reference_reply: Please stop using and charging the device immediately for safety. Reach out in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport so we can arrange urgent priority service.

customer_text: I replaced my battery at a third party shop and now it will not power on at all.
reference_reply: Third party repairs can affect device circuitry. Join us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport so we can explore repair options.

customer_text: My iPhone will not turn on or respond to hard reset after dying completely.
reference_reply: Leave it plugged into a known working wall charger for at least 30 minutes without touching it, then try the forced restart steps.

customer_text: Battery health capacity dropped 5% in one week.
reference_reply: Battery capacity recalculates periodically after software updates. Which iOS version is currently running on your device?

customer_text: Fast charging is not working with my USB-C 29W power adapter.
reference_reply: Fast charging requires an official Apple USB-C to Lightning cable on iPhone 8 or later. Which cable model are you using?

customer_text: Phone turns off in cold weather even with 50% battery remaining.
reference_reply: Lithium-ion batteries have a temporary shortened lifespan in low temperatures. Warm the phone to room temperature and restart.

customer_text: Battery usage screen is completely blank and says Usage will be shown after using iPhone for a few minutes.
reference_reply: Give it a full charge cycle to 100% to let iOS generate usage metrics. Let us know if it does not appear after 24 hours.

customer_text: Can I get a battery replacement for  out of warranty?
reference_reply: We can check the eligible battery replacement pricing for your specific serial number. Join us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: Is it safe to charge my iPhone with a 87W MacBook Pro charger?
reference_reply: Yes! Apple 29W, 30W, 61W, and 87W USB-C adapters are safe and support USB Power Delivery fast charging on compatible devices.

customer_text: My iPad Pro shuts off whenever battery hits 15%.
reference_reply: Let us perform a force restart by holding the Top and Home (or Volume) buttons until the Apple logo appears. Does it repeat?

customer_text: Screen brightness dims automatically because the device is too warm.
reference_reply: This is expected thermal management to protect internal components. Move the device to a cooler environment out of direct sunlight.

customer_text: My battery drained 40% while listening to music with screen locked.
reference_reply: Check Settings > Battery > Show Activity to see if background streaming or equalizer apps were active.

customer_text: Why does low power mode turn off automatically at 80%?
reference_reply: Low Power Mode automatically disengages at 80% charge because your device has sufficient power for normal background tasks.

customer_text: iPhone is stuck on the Apple logo with progress bar not moving for 2 hours.
reference_reply: Let us put the device into Recovery Mode and update through a computer without erasing your data. Do you have a Mac or PC available?

customer_text: I keep getting Software Update Failed when trying to download iOS 11.2 over Wi-Fi.
reference_reply: Check Settings > General > iPhone Storage to ensure you have at least 3-4GB free, or try updating through iTunes/Finder.

customer_text: After updating to iOS 11, my camera app shows only a black screen.
reference_reply: Force close the Camera app and restart your device. If it persists, does the front-facing camera work in FaceTime?

customer_text: My phone is in a boot loop restarting every 30 seconds after the OTA update.
reference_reply: Connect your iPhone to a computer, open iTunes/Finder, and force restart into Recovery Mode to select Update.

customer_text: iTunes error 4013 occurred while trying to restore my iPhone 7.
reference_reply: Error 4013 usually relates to USB connection. Try a different Apple USB cable, another USB port, and ensure your computer OS is up to date.

customer_text: Can I downgrade my iOS back to iOS 10? The new update is ruined.
reference_reply: Apple does not support downgrading to unsigned iOS versions to maintain security and stability. We are happy to troubleshoot any bugs.

customer_text: All my contacts disappeared after the update finished.
reference_reply: Check Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud and make sure Contacts is toggled on. If using Google/Exchange, check Settings > Accounts.

customer_text: Keyboard lag is terrible on iOS 11.1 typing anything takes 5 seconds.
reference_reply: Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Keyboard Dictionary. Does that restore typing speed?

customer_text: My iPhone says Verifying update and has been stuck like that for 40 minutes.
reference_reply: Press the power button to lock the screen, wake it, and if still stuck, perform a forced restart to restart the verification.

customer_text: Storage says System Data / Other is taking up 45GB out of 64GB after updating.
reference_reply: Back up your iPhone to iCloud or a computer, then perform an Erase All Content & Settings and restore the backup.

customer_text: Bluetooth toggle in Control Center does not turn off Bluetooth completely in iOS 11.
reference_reply: In iOS 11, Control Center disconnects accessories but leaves Bluetooth active for AirDrop and Apple Watch. Turn it off in Settings.

customer_text: Calculator app gives 24 when typing 1+2+3 quickly on iOS 11!
reference_reply: We are aware of the animation delay in the calculator app and a software update fix is rolling out. Thank you for reporting!

customer_text: Apps keep crashing on launch immediately following the latest security patch.
reference_reply: Check the App Store to ensure all your third-party apps are updated to their latest compatible versions.

customer_text: Unable to install update because An error occurred installing iOS.
reference_reply: Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage, find the iOS update download file, delete it, and download it again over Wi-Fi.

customer_text: Will updating to iOS 11 delete my photos or text messages?
reference_reply: Standard updates preserve your data, but we always recommend making an iCloud or computer backup beforehand for safety.

customer_text: My phone is stuck on Attempting data recovery screen.
reference_reply: Allow the process to complete, which can take up to an hour. Do not disconnect or force restart while it is running.

customer_text: Touch ID stopped working completely after installing iOS 11.2.
reference_reply: Go to Settings > Touch ID & Passcode, delete your existing fingerprints, and re-enroll them. Does the sensor respond?

customer_text: How long does the iOS 11 installation usually take?
reference_reply: Downloading depends on your Wi-Fi connection; the installation itself typically takes 15 to 30 minutes once downloaded.

customer_text: Update deleted my music library from Apple Music.
reference_reply: Check Settings > Music and make sure Sync Library or iCloud Music Library is toggled ON with your active Apple ID.

customer_text: My iPhone will not connect to iTunes on Windows 10, says driver missing.
reference_reply: Update Windows and check Device Manager under Universal Serial Bus devices for the Apple Mobile Device USB Driver.

customer_text: Software update button is greyed out and says Checking for Update...
reference_reply: Toggle Airplane Mode on and off, ensure low power mode is disabled, and connect to a known stable Wi-Fi network.

customer_text: My Apple Watch update has been paused on Estimating time remaining forever.
reference_reply: Ensure your Apple Watch is on its charger and in range of your iPhone connected to Wi-Fi. Restart both devices.

customer_text: Screen rotation is locked even though portrait lock is off in Control Center.
reference_reply: Force close the affected app and restart your device. Does rotation work across native apps like Safari or Photos?

customer_text: I am on the iOS public beta and want to go back to official release.
reference_reply: Remove the iOS Beta Profile from Settings > General > VPN & Device Management, then restart. You will receive the next public update.

customer_text: Update bricked my phone completely, it only shows a black screen and will not connect to PC.

customer_text: How do I cancel two-factor authentication on my Apple ID?
reference_reply: Two-factor authentication cannot be turned off on newer accounts created on iOS 10.3 or later to ensure account security.

customer_text: My iCloud storage is full even though I deleted thousands of photos and videos.
reference_reply: Make sure to check the Recently Deleted album in the Photos app and empty it, as deleted photos stay there for 30 days.

customer_text: My photos are not syncing across to my iPad from iCloud.

customer_text: Activation Lock is on a phone I purchased secondhand and I cannot reach the seller.
reference_reply: Activation Lock can only be removed by the original owner or with valid proof of purchase. Reach out in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: I keep getting prompt Apple ID Verification - Enter the password for account repeatedly.

customer_text: How do I transfer all my iCloud data to a new Apple ID email address?
reference_reply: You can change your Apple ID email address directly at https://appleid.apple.com without needing to create a new account.

customer_text: Is it possible to recover notes that were permanently deleted from iCloud?
reference_reply: Check the Recently Deleted folder inside the Notes app. If they were synced with an email provider, check your email webmail.

customer_text: Suspicious login attempt from another state alert showed up on my iPhone.
reference_reply: If you did not initiate this login, tap Do Not Allow immediately and change your Apple ID password at https://iforgot.apple.com.

customer_text: My iCloud backup failed because there is not enough storage space.
reference_reply: You can manage backup size in Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Manage Storage > Backups, or upgrade your iCloud storage plan.

customer_text: I forgot my iPhone screen passcode and the phone is disabled.
reference_reply: A disabled device must be restored using a computer in recovery mode or through iCloud Find My iPhone erase device feature.

customer_text: How do I remove an old device from my Apple ID account?
reference_reply: Go to Settings > [Your Name], scroll down to your device list, select the old device, and tap Remove from Account.

customer_text: My family sharing is not sharing iCloud storage with my daughter.
reference_reply: Ensure you have a 200GB or 2TB iCloud plan, and go to Settings > [Your Name] > Family Sharing > iCloud Storage to invite her.

customer_text: My keychain passwords disappeared after signing out of iCloud.
reference_reply: Sign back into your Apple ID and ensure iCloud Keychain is toggled ON under Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Keychain.

customer_text: Someone hacked my Apple ID and changed the recovery email address!
reference_reply: Account security is critical. Please DM us immediately at https://apple.co/DMSupport with your details so we can assist.

customer_text: Can I change my @icloud.com primary email alias?
reference_reply: Primary @icloud.com addresses cannot be changed once created, but you can create up to 3 email aliases on iCloud.com.

customer_text: Find My iPhone says device is offline even though it is turned on.
reference_reply: A device appears offline if it loses cellular/Wi-Fi connection, battery is depleted, or location services are disabled.

customer_text: How do I turn off Activation Lock before selling my iPhone?
reference_reply: Sign out of iCloud from Settings > [Your Name] > Sign Out, then go to General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Erase All Content.

customer_text: I am stuck in account recovery for 7 days, can you speed it up?
reference_reply: Account Recovery is completely automated to protect privacy, but we can verify status in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: My messages in iCloud are not downloading on my new Mac.

customer_text: How do I remove my credit card from my Apple ID if I do not want any card on file?
reference_reply: Go to Settings > [Your Name] > Payment & Shipping > Edit. If you have active subscriptions or an unpaid balance, you may need a card on file.

customer_text: I received an email receipt for an iPhone app purchase I never authorized.

reference_reply: Update or add a valid payment method in Settings > [Your Name] > Payment & Shipping to settle the pending balance.

customer_text: How do I share purchased apps with my family members without sharing credit card?
reference_reply: Set up Family Sharing with Purchase Sharing. The family organizer pays for shared purchases, or members can use gift card balance.

reference_reply: Go to Settings > [Your Name] > Media & Purchases > View Account > Purchase History.

customer_text: I bought an app by mistake 10 minutes ago, can I cancel the charge immediately?
reference_reply: Visit https://reportaproblem.apple.com, sign in with your Apple ID, find the app and choose Request a Refund.

customer_text: How do I turn on Ask to Buy for my child Apple ID?
reference_reply: As the family organizer, go to Settings > [Your Name] > Family Sharing, tap your child name, and toggle Ask to Buy ON.

customer_text: Can I change my App Store country without losing my purchased apps?
reference_reply: You must spend remaining store balance and cancel active subscriptions first. You can re-download apps available in the new region.

customer_text: I suspect fraudulent charges on my Apple ID totaling over  today.
reference_reply: We take unauthorized charges very seriously. Please DM us immediately: https://apple.co/DMSupport so we can secure the account.

customer_text: Where can I find the invoice VAT ID for my company Apple purchase?
reference_reply: Invoices with VAT details are emailed to your billing address and can also be downloaded from https://reportaproblem.apple.com.

customer_text: My subscription says Expiring soon but I already renewed it.
reference_reply: App Store subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of the current billing period. Check Settings > [Your Name] > Subscriptions.

customer_text: My iPhone will not connect to my home Wi-Fi network after resetting router.
reference_reply: Try tapping Settings > Wi-Fi > (i) next to your network > Forget This Network, then reconnect. You can also Reset Network Settings.

customer_text: AirPods sound very low in the left ear compared to the right ear.
reference_reply: Check Settings > Accessibility > Audio/Visual and ensure the Balance slider is centered. Also check the earbud mesh for earwax.

customer_text: iPhone says No Service and will not make phone calls or send texts.
reference_reply: Toggle Airplane Mode on and off, restart your phone, and check for a Carrier Settings update under Settings > General > About.

customer_text: Bluetooth disconnects from my car every time I get an incoming call.
reference_reply: Forget the car stereo in Settings > Bluetooth, delete the iPhone from your car dash, and pair them again from scratch.

customer_text: People cannot hear me during phone calls unless I put them on speakerphone.
reference_reply: This points to the bottom microphone. Test it by recording a voice memo in Voice Memos. Is the playback clear?

customer_text: My Wi-Fi button in Settings is completely greyed out and cannot be turned on.
reference_reply: A greyed-out Wi-Fi toggle typically indicates a hardware issue with the Wi-Fi chip. DM us: https://apple.co/DMSupport for service options.

customer_text: AirPods microphone sounds like I am underwater when on phone calls.
reference_reply: Clean the microphone openings at the bottom of the AirPods stems and test them with Voice Memos. Try resetting the AirPods in the case.

customer_text: iPhone drops cellular connection repeatedly every few minutes.
reference_reply: Try removing and reseating the physical SIM card, or contact your carrier to ensure network provisioning is active.

customer_text: Cannot connect to 5GHz Wi-Fi network, only 2.4GHz appears.
reference_reply: Ensure your router is broadcasting the 5GHz SSID and restart both the router and iPhone. Which iPhone model do you have?

customer_text: Speaker crackles loudly whenever playing media at high volume.
reference_reply: Check the speaker mesh at the bottom for any dirt. Does the crackling occur across all audio apps or just one?

customer_text: My iPhone will not pair with my Apple Watch Series 3.
reference_reply: Make sure both devices have Bluetooth enabled and are connected to Wi-Fi. Try restarting both devices and opening the Watch app.

customer_text: Personal Hotspot disappeared from Settings menu completely.
reference_reply: Personal Hotspot is controlled by your carrier. Check Settings > Cellular to see if Personal Hotspot is configured there.

customer_text: AirPods case will not show the amber or green LED light when opened.
reference_reply: Plug the case into a known working Apple charger for 30 minutes, then press and hold the setup button on the back for 15 seconds.

customer_text: Cannot hear caller through the receiver speaker during normal phone call.
reference_reply: Ensure the plastic protective film was removed from the screen receiver, and clean the receiver mesh with a clean dry brush.

customer_text: Bluetooth icon is greyed out in Control Center and spinning in Settings.
reference_reply: Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings. Note this resets saved Wi-Fi passwords.

customer_text: My iPhone will not connect to public hotel Wi-Fi login splash page.
reference_reply: Open Safari and type captive.apple.com or 1.1.1.1 in the address bar to manually trigger the hotel login portal.

customer_text: Only one AirPod connects at a time when taking them out of the case.
reference_reply: Place both AirPods in the case, close the lid for 30 seconds, open it, and hold the back button until the light flashes amber then white.

customer_text: Microphone does not work when recording video on the rear camera.
reference_reply: The rear camera uses the mic between the camera lens and true tone flash. Ensure your case is not blocking this small opening.

customer_text: CarPlay will not recognize my iPhone when plugged in via lightning cable.
reference_reply: Ensure CarPlay is enabled under Settings > General > CarPlay, check that Siri is ON, and try an official Apple USB cable.

customer_text: AirDrop does not discover nearby contacts even with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on.
reference_reply: Set AirDrop to Everyone for 10 Minutes in Control Center to test. Ensure Personal Hotspot is toggled off on both devices.

customer_text: Volume buttons on the side of iPhone are not changing audio volume.
reference_reply: Check Settings > Sounds & Haptics and ensure Change with Buttons is toggled ON. Do the buttons physically click normally?

customer_text: Cellular data is extremely slow, speed test shows 0.1 Mbps on LTE.
reference_reply: Toggle Airplane mode for 10 seconds. Check with your carrier whether you have reached high-speed data throttling thresholds.

customer_text: My iPhone keeps switching from Wi-Fi to LTE randomly.
reference_reply: Check Settings > Cellular, scroll to the bottom, and toggle Wi-Fi Assist OFF to prevent automatic switching on weak Wi-Fi.

customer_text: Both AirPods have static and popping noises during phone calls.
reference_reply: Ensure the paired device is nearby and free of wireless interference. Update your iPhone to the latest iOS to update AirPods firmware.

reference_reply: Apple Watch screen repairs generally involve a full unit replacement to preserve water resistance. Details are at support.apple.com/watch/repair.

reference_reply: Persistent image retention on OLED displays can be assessed under warranty. Please DM us: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

reference_reply: Same-day battery replacements are typically available depending on part inventory and appointment availability at your local store.

reference_reply: You can check daily store hours, workshop schedules, and directions for Covent Garden at https://apple.com/retail/coventgarden.

customer_text: Do you offer student discounts on the new iPad Pro?
reference_reply: Yes! Verified students, parents, and educators can access educational pricing at the Apple Education Store: https://apple.com/us-hed/shop.

customer_text: Just upgraded to iPhone X and I absolutely love Animoji! Great job Apple!
reference_reply: That is wonderful to hear! We love Animoji too. Enjoy your new iPhone X, and do not hesitate to reach out if you need anything.

customer_text: Can I trade in an iPhone 6 towards an iPhone 8 in the store?
reference_reply: Yes, you can trade in eligible devices in-store or online for credit or an Apple Gift Card at https://apple.com/shop/trade-in.

customer_text: How do I track my online order delivery status for my new Mac?
reference_reply: You can track your shipment and view delivery estimates by signing into https://apple.com/orderstatus with your Apple ID.

customer_text: Does the iPhone 8 come with fast charger in the box?
reference_reply: The iPhone 8 includes a standard 5W USB power adapter in the box. Fast charging requires a separate USB-C power adapter and cable.

customer_text: Can I return an opened iPad within 14 days for a full refund?
reference_reply: Yes, items purchased directly from Apple can be returned within 14 calendar days from delivery in original packaging.

customer_text: Are Apple Stores open on Christmas Day?
reference_reply: Apple Retail Stores are typically closed on Christmas Day. Check your local store hours at https://apple.com/retail.

customer_text: Where can I submit a feature request for the next version of iOS?
reference_reply: We welcome customer feedback! You can submit direct feature suggestions to our engineering team at https://apple.com/feedback.

customer_text: Can someone tell me the difference between AppleCare and AppleCare+?
reference_reply: AppleCare+ extends warranty coverage and adds accidental damage protection for a service fee, whereas standard AppleCare is limited.

customer_text: Does Apple offer recycling for old batteries and obsolete devices?
reference_reply: Yes! We offer free responsible recycling for any Apple device or battery at any Apple Store or online via Apple Trade In.

customer_text: Can I buy AppleCare+ after I already purchased my iPhone a month ago?
reference_reply: You can purchase AppleCare+ within 60 days of your iPhone purchase via Settings > General > About or online after remote diagnostics.

customer_text: Is the Apple pencil compatible with the iPhone 8 Plus?
reference_reply: Apple Pencil is designed exclusively for supported iPad models and is not compatible with iPhone.

customer_text: Why is your customer support queue taking so long today?
reference_reply: We apologize for the wait! We are experiencing higher volume than usual today. We are here and ready to help you right now.

customer_text: Can I engrave my AirPods case for free when ordering online?
reference_reply: Yes, complimentary personalized laser engraving is available exclusively when ordering online through Apple.com.

customer_text: Where can I find user manuals for older Mac models?
reference_reply: All Apple product user guides, technical specifications, and manuals are archived at https://support.apple.com/manuals.

customer_text: Do you sell refurbished iPhones directly on your website?
reference_reply: Yes, Apple Certified Refurbished devices with full 1-year warranty are available on the Refurbished section of Apple.com.

customer_text: What are the system requirements for running macOS High Sierra?
reference_reply: macOS High Sierra requires a compatible Mac from late 2009 or later and at least 2GB of RAM. Full list at support.apple.com/HT208969.

customer_text: Can I use an Apple Store gift card to pay for iCloud monthly storage?
reference_reply: Yes, when you redeem an Apple Gift Card to your Apple ID balance, it will automatically cover monthly iCloud storage invoices.

customer_text: Does Apple have a corporate trade-in program for businesses with 50 laptops?
reference_reply: Yes! Our Apple at Work business team handles volume recycling and trade-in. Learn more at https://apple.com/business.

customer_text: How do I schedule an in-person Today at Apple photography session?
reference_reply: You can explore and book free Today at Apple creative sessions at your nearest store by visiting https://apple.com/today.

customer_text: I lost my iPhone in a taxi in London, what should I do first?
reference_reply: Mark the device as Lost immediately at https://icloud.com/find. This locks it with a passcode, disables Apple Pay, and tracks location.

customer_text: Can I use two different Apple IDs for iCloud and iTunes App Store?
reference_reply: Yes, you can use one Apple ID for iCloud data sync and a different Apple ID for Media & Purchases in Settings.

customer_text: Is the new Steve Jobs Theater open for public tours?
reference_reply: Steve Jobs Theater is closed to general public tours, but visitors can explore the Apple Park Visitor Center and its rooftop deck.

customer_text: I love the new store architecture in Chicago Michigan Avenue!
reference_reply: Thank you! Our Chicago store on Michigan Avenue was designed to connect the city with the river. We hope you visit often!

customer_text: I installed iOS 11.2 last night and now my battery drops from 100 to 0 in two hours and the phone is boiling hot!
reference_reply: Post-update background processes can cause temporary battery drain and warmth for 24-48 hours. Check Settings > Battery to monitor apps.

customer_text: I cannot login to my Apple ID to cancel a subscription that just billed me .99!
reference_reply: We can help you regain account access and review the subscription charge safely. Join us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: Wow Apple, thank you for the wonderful Christmas gift of a  phone that dies if I look at it for five minutes!
reference_reply: We understand how frustrating that is and want to help. Head to Settings > Battery > Battery Health. What capacity does it show?

customer_text: My Apple ID is john.doe@sample.com, serial is FK2W12345, please reset my password!
reference_reply: For your security, never share emails or serial numbers publicly. Please delete your tweet and join us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: Worst customer service ever. Three weeks without a working phone. I am taking all four of my family lines to Android tomorrow!
reference_reply: We sincerely apologize for your experience and want to turn this around. Please DM us your case number: https://apple.co/DMSupport so a senior advisor can step in.

customer_text: My screen will not respond to touch after my toddler threw it down the stairs, but there is no crack on the outside.
reference_reply: An internal impact can disconnect or damage the display digitizer. Join us in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport to set up diagnostic testing.

customer_text: I already reset my network settings, restored from iTunes, and got a new SIM card. No Service is STILL there!
reference_reply: Since standard troubleshooting has not resolved the No Service alert, let us look into hardware service options. DM us: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: It broke.
reference_reply: We are here to help! Could you let us know which Apple device you have and what specific issue you are experiencing?

customer_text: I jailbroke my iPhone 7 on iOS 10.2 and Cydia keeps crashing. Can you help me fix it?
reference_reply: Unauthorized modification of iOS violates the software license agreement. You can restore your iPhone to official factory software using iTunes.

customer_text: A detective needs access to a deceased relative locked iPhone for an active investigation. Who do they contact?
reference_reply: Please review our legal process guidelines at https://apple.com/privacy/government-information-requests or DM us: https://apple.co/DMSupport for legal team routing.

customer_text: People hear static when I call them on Bluetooth in my car, but wired headphones sound crystal clear.
reference_reply: This suggests an issue with the car Bluetooth link rather than the phone microphone. Forget and re-pair the car in Settings > Bluetooth.
notes: Disentangling car BT from phone mic

customer_text: Got an SMS from Apple-Security-Login.com saying my iCloud is suspended unless I enter my credit card. Is this real?
reference_reply: This is a phishing attempt. Apple never sends SMS links asking for credit cards. Do not click, and forward it to reportphishing@apple.com.

customer_text: A grain of sand is jammed deep inside my lightning port and the charger will not seat properly.
reference_reply: Gently inspect with a flashlight and use a dry, non-conductive wooden toothpick to coax it out without touching the metallic pins. Do not use metal.

customer_text: My Apple Watch screen popped off its frame and there is a sweet chemical smell coming from it!
reference_reply: Please remove the watch, store it in an open ventilated fireproof container, and DM us immediately: https://apple.co/DMSupport for urgent assistance.

customer_text: If you do not refund this unauthorized .99 in-app charge by 5 PM I am filing a credit card fraud chargeback with Chase!
reference_reply: We want to resolve this charge with you immediately. Please connect with our senior billing team in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: I dropped my phone in the sink yesterday. I dried it, but now the speaker sounds like a tin can.
reference_reply: Moisture inside the acoustic chamber can cause permanent diaphragm damage. Reach out in DM: https://apple.co/DMSupport for hardware evaluation.

customer_text: Spotify will not stream music over my AirPods even though my Spotify Premium subscription is paid.
reference_reply: Test if Apple Music or YouTube plays audio through your AirPods. If they work, try uninstalling and reinstalling the Spotify app.

customer_text: My password, email, and phone number were all changed on my Apple ID an hour ago. I am completely locked out!
reference_reply: This requires immediate account security intervention. Please DM us right away: https://apple.co/DMSupport with any reference numbers.

customer_text: Apple Trade-In quoted me  for my MacBook but your warehouse sent an email saying  because of damage that was not there!
reference_reply: We would be glad to look into your trade-in inspection photos and re-evaluation. Please DM us your Trade-In Quote ID: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: Why does my keyboard type an A and a question mark symbol [?] every time I type the letter I?
reference_reply: This was resolved in iOS 11.1.1! Go to Settings > General > Software Update to install the update and resolve the autocorrect symbol bug.

customer_text: My battery was at 60% while skiing in Colorado and the phone died. Turned back on at 55% once inside the lodge.
reference_reply: Operating temperatures below 32°F (0°C) temporarily alter lithium-ion discharge curves. The battery returns to normal capacity at room temperature.

customer_text: My 8-year-old spent  on Roblox coins without my permission on our shared family iPad!
reference_reply: We can assist you in filing an unauthorized minor purchase refund and enabling Screen Time restrictions. Please DM us: https://apple.co/DMSupport.

customer_text: Shoutout to Apple for giving me a free hand warmer with my iPhone 7 whenever I open Instagram!
reference_reply: While we appreciate the humor, excessive warmth is not ideal! Check Settings > Battery to see Instagram background activity, and ensure the app is updated.

customer_text: Just put a glass screen protector on my new iPhone and now typing is missing every third letter.
reference_reply: Ensure the screen protector is fully adhered without air bubbles or dust underneath. If it is too thick, test the screen without the protector.

customer_text: Is there any way to eliminate the 200ms audio latency when monitoring Logic Pro X tracks through AirPods?
reference_reply: Bluetooth AAC encoding inherently introduces a buffer latency unsuited for real-time music monitoring. We recommend wired headphones for DAW tracking.
